_: GUTLOG_V3380_KITCHEN. Personal adjustments for a Family Kitchen recipe, evaluated inside each person's own GutLog against that person's own record (conditions, lab values, Food Test outcomes, the medicine classes their own RxGuard reports, height and weight). Generic: no person and no medicine is named here -- a medicine's name appears on a card only when it comes from that person's own RxGuard. The shared recipe is never changed; only the card the person sees. Every rule that fires puts a 'modified' badge on the card with its reason. Rules are applied in this order.

to.text: a pinch of hing in the hot oil

rules.reason: Onion and garlic swapped for a pinch of hing, because IBS is recorded.
Pulses kept to {limit} g a serving, the amount the Food Test settled on.
Rice, flour, potato and sugar kept to three-quarters, because a raised HbA1c or diabetes is recorded. A sweet once a day at most.
Keep the salt as written -- do not cut it -- because low sodium is recorded.

to.text: ordinary salt, as the recipe needs

rules.reason: Never a potassium 'low-sodium' salt with {classes}: the two together can push potassium up.
Ghee and oil halved, because high cholesterol is recorded. Protein up where the dish allows.
Four-fifths of a serving, for weight (BMI {bmi} from the recorded height and weight).
No grapefruit: it raises the blood levels of {meds} (RxGuard: CYP3A4).
